# PRIMER VERTICAL SLICE TÉCNICO

Yo le daría a Codex exactamente esta secuencia:

### Fase 1 — Solution

Crear proyectos y referencias.

Debe compilar todo sin gameplay.

### Fase 2 — Servidor

Servidor inicia.

```text
Listening...
```

### Fase 3 — Cliente

Godot abre `Main`.

Conecta a localhost.

### Fase 4 — Handshake

```text
ClientHello
ServerHello
ProtocolVersion
```

### Fase 5 — Test character

Servidor crea:

```text
PlayerEntity
STR
INT
AGI
SPI
VIT
HP
PM
```

### Fase 6 — Test map

Cliente carga mapa pequeño.

### Fase 7 — Spawn

Servidor:

```text
EntityEnter(Player)
```

cliente crea `PlayerView`.

### Fase 8 — Movement

Input → servidor → snapshot → render.

### Fase 9 — Segundo cliente

Abrimos dos clientes.

Ambos se ven moverse.

**Aquí tenemos oficialmente la semilla de un MMO.**

### Fase 10 — NPC

Servidor spawnea `NpcEntity`.

Ambos clientes lo ven.

### Fase 11 — Interaction

Jugador se acerca.

```text
Interact NPC
```

servidor devuelve:

```text
"Hola mundo."
```

### Fase 12 — Item

Servidor crea `ItemInstance`.

Cliente recibe inventario.

### Fase 13 — Equip

Jugador solicita equipar.

Servidor recalcula.

Cliente recibe:

```text
EquipmentDelta
AttributeDelta
```

### Fase 14 — Persistence

Logout/login.

Personaje conserva:

- posición;
- atributos;
- inventario;
- equipo.

Ese vertical slice vale muchísimo más ahora mismo que intentar construir combate.

---

# REGLA TÉCNICA MAESTRA

Quiero dejar una especialmente grabada:

> **Una escena representa algo; una Definition describe algo; una Entity es algo que existe; un System decide reglas; un Message comunica; una View muestra; la Database persiste.**

Si una clase comienza a hacer cuatro de esas cosas:

> está mal separada.

Y una segunda:

> **Godot no debe saber cómo funciona el servidor, y el servidor no debe saber cómo Godot dibuja el juego.**

Eso es lo que nos permitirá seguir diseñando mecánicas durante meses sin que Codex tenga que demoler el proyecto cada vez.

Esta arquitectura ya es suficientemente concreta para convertirla en un **Bloque Técnico canónico** y darle trabajo real a Codex. El siguiente paso técnico debería ser aterrizar **exactamente los proyectos `.csproj`, namespaces, dependencias permitidas, árbol de escenas Godot y flujo de arranque**, hasta dejarle un primer prompt de implementación prácticamente copiables. citeturn325839search0turn325839search4turn325839search12

using Mmo.Content;
using Mmo.Domain;
using Mmo.Protocol;

using Mmo.Server.Domain;
using Mmo.Server.Entities;
using Mmo.Server.Fixtures;
using Mmo.Server.Maps;
using Mmo.Server.Persistence;
using Mmo.Server.Services;

namespace Mmo.Server;

/// <summary>
/// Runtime autoritativo del mundo.
/// Coordina sesiones, entidades, mapas, movimiento, interacción, inventario,
/// equipamiento y persistencia. No depende de Godot.
/// 
/// IMPORTANTE:
/// - La lógica de contenido no debe crecer aquí.
/// - World orquesta; los sistemas especializados ejecutan reglas.
/// - Todas las mutaciones públicas deben ejecutarse bajo Gate desde el host.
/// </summary>
public sealed class World
{
    public const int TickMilliseconds = 50;

    public object Gate { get; } = new();

    private readonly Dictionary<string, Player> players = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly EntityRegistry<WorldEntity> entities = new(entity => entity.EntityId);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> interactionResults = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);

    private readonly SliceFixture fixture;
    private readonly ICharacterRepository? repository;

    private readonly IMapManager mapManager;
    private readonly ItemDefinitionCatalog itemCatalog;
    private readonly MapCatalog mapCatalog;
    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, ItemDefinition> itemDefinitions;

    private readonly FixtureAttributeCalculator attributeCalculator;
    private readonly MovementService movement;
    private readonly EquipmentService equipment;
    private readonly EntityInteractionService interactions;
    private readonly InventoryService inventory;
    private readonly ActionDispatcher actions;

    public long Tick { get; private set; }

    public IEnumerable<WorldEntity> Entities => entities.All;
    public IReadOnlyCollection<MapInstance> MapInstances => mapManager.All;

    public ItemDefinitionCatalog Items => itemCatalog;
    public MapCatalog Maps => mapCatalog;

    /// <summary>
    /// Compatibilidad temporal con el slice técnico.
    /// No usar como fuente global de mapa en código nuevo.
    /// </summary>
    public MapInstance Instance => mapManager.Resolve(fixture.MapId);

    public int Width => Instance.Definition.Width;
    public int Height => Instance.Definition.Height;

    public World(
        SliceFixture fixture,
        ICharacterRepository? repository = null,
        ContentPackage? content = null,
        IMapManager? mapManager = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fixture);

        this.fixture = fixture;
        this.repository = repository;

        if (content is not null)
            ContentCompiler.Validate(content, null);

        itemCatalog = content is null
            ? fixture.CreateItemCatalog()
            : new ItemDefinitionCatalog(content.Items);

        mapCatalog = content is null
            ? fixture.CreateMapCatalog()
            : new MapCatalog(content.Maps);

        itemDefinitions = itemCatalog.All.ToDictionary(
            item => item.Id,
            StringComparer.Ordinal);

        attributeCalculator = new FixtureAttributeCalculator();
        movement = new MovementService();
        interactions = new EntityInteractionService();
        inventory = new InventoryService();
        equipment = new EquipmentService(attributeCalculator);

        this.mapManager = mapManager ?? BuildDefaultMapManager(mapCatalog, fixture.SpatialCellSize);

        var policy = new FixtureInteractionPolicy(
            fixture.InteractionRange,
            fixture.Greeting);

        actions = new ActionDispatcher(policy, policy);

        SpawnInitialContent(content);
    }

    public sealed class Player : PlayerSession
    {
        public Player(string token, Character character)
            : base(token, character)
        {
        }
    }

    #region Session lifecycle

    public Player Join(string? token) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token)
            ? CreateCharacter()
            : LoadCharacter(token);

    public Player CreateCharacter(string? name = null)
    {
        if (players.Count >= 32)
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Límite del slice técnico alcanzado; reinicia el servidor.");

        var spawnInstance = mapManager.Resolve(fixture.MapId);

        var spawnPoint = spawnInstance.Definition.SpawnPoints.FirstOrDefault()
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"El mapa inicial '{fixture.MapId}' no tiene punto de aparición.");

        var spawnPosition = new WorldPosition(spawnPoint.X, spawnPoint.Y);

        if (!spawnInstance.Runtime.CanOccupy(spawnPosition.X, spawnPosition.Y))
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"El punto de aparición del mapa '{fixture.MapId}' está bloqueado.");

        var token = Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32));

        var starterItem = CreateStarterItem();

        var character = new Character(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            NormalizeCharacterName(name),
            fixture.MapId,
            spawnPosition,
            new CharacterAttributes(
                new Dictionary<PrimaryStat, decimal>(fixture.BaseStats),
                new Dictionary<SecondaryStat, decimal>(),
                new Dictionary<TertiaryStat, decimal>()),
            new ResourceValue(fixture.HP, fixture.HP),
            new ResourceValue(fixture.PM, fixture.PM),
            [starterItem],
            new EquipmentLoadout(new Dictionary<EquipmentSlot, Guid>()));

        CharacterValidation.Validate(character);

        var player = new Player(token, character);
        player.Connect();

        players.Add(token, player);

        try
        {
            AddEntity(player.Entity);
            Persist(player);
        }
        catch
        {
            players.Remove(token);
            throw;
        }

        return player;
    }

    public Player LoadCharacter(string token)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Token de personaje requerido.");

        if (players.TryGetValue(token, out var cached))
        {
            if (cached.Connected)
                throw new InvalidDataException("Personaje ya conectado.");

            ValidateCharacterWorldState(cached.Character);
            cached.Connect();
            return cached;
        }

        var saved = repository?.Load(token)
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Personaje inexistente.");

        CharacterValidation.Validate(saved);
        ValidateCharacterWorldState(saved);
        ValidateInventory(saved);

        var player = new Player(token, saved);
        players.Add(token, player);

        try
        {
            AddEntity(player.Entity);
            player.Connect();
        }
        catch
        {
            players.Remove(token);
            throw;
        }

        return player;
    }

    public void Leave(Player player)
    {
        ValidateOwnedPlayer(player);

        Persist(player);

        player.Entity.InputX = 0;
        player.Entity.InputY = 0;
        player.Entity.ClearTarget();
        player.Disconnect();

        // La entidad permanece en memoria para reanudación rápida durante este
        // prototipo. En producción, SessionManager decidirá cuándo descargarla.
    }

    public void Checkpoint()
    {
        if (repository is null)
            return;

        foreach (var player in players.Values.Where(player => player.Connected))
            repository.Save(player.Token, player.Character);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Commands

    public void Apply(Player player, ClientMessage message)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(player);

        ProtocolValidation.ValidateCommand(message, player.LastSequence);

        switch (message.Kind)
        {
            case MessageKinds.Move:
                movement.ApplyInput(player.Entity, message.X, message.Y);
                break;

            case MessageKinds.Equip:
                HandleEquip(player, message);
                break;

            case MessageKinds.Target:
                HandleTarget(player, message);
                break;

            case MessageKinds.Interact:
                HandleInteract(player, message);
                break;

            default:
                throw new InvalidDataException(
                    $"Comando no soportado por World: {message.Kind}");
        }

        player.LastSequence = message.Sequence;
    }

    private void HandleEquip(Player player, ClientMessage message)
    {
        var itemId = message.ItemId
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Equipamiento sin objeto.");

        var item = player.Character.Inventory.SingleOrDefault(item => item.Id == itemId)
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Objeto ajeno o inexistente.");

        var basis = player.Character with
        {
            Attributes = player.Character.Attributes with
            {
                Primary = new Dictionary<PrimaryStat, decimal>(fixture.BaseStats)
            }
        };

        player.Character = equipment.Equip(
            basis,
            item,
            new EquipmentSlot("fixture-slot"),
            itemDefinitions,
            basis.Attributes);

        Persist(player);
    }

    private void HandleTarget(Player player, ClientMessage message)
    {
        var targetId = message.TargetId
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Objetivo sin entidad.");

        if (!TryTarget(player.Entity.EntityId, new EntityId(targetId)))
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Objetivo inexistente, fuera del mapa, fuera de instancia o no visible.");
    }

    private void HandleInteract(Player player, ClientMessage message)
    {
        var targetId = message.TargetId
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Interacción sin objetivo.");

        if (!entities.TryGet(new EntityId(targetId), out var target))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Objetivo inexistente.");

        if (!SharesRuntimeSpace(player.Entity, target))
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "El objetivo no pertenece al mismo mapa/instancia.");

        var result = actions.Execute(
            player.Entity,
            target,
            message.InteractionId
                ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Interacción sin ID."));

        interactionResults[player.Token] = result.Message;
    }

    #endregion

    #region World update

    public void Step(int tickMilliseconds = TickMilliseconds)
    {
        if (tickMilliseconds <= 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(tickMilliseconds));

        Tick++;

        var snapshot = entities.All.ToArray();

        foreach (var entity in snapshot)
        {
            if (!entity.IsDisposed)
                entity.Update(Tick);
        }

        foreach (var character in snapshot
                     .OfType<CharacterEntity>()
                     .Where(entity => entity.Connected && !entity.IsDisposed))
        {
            if (!TryResolveInstance(character, out var instance))
                continue;

            movement.Step(
                character,
                instance.Runtime,
                fixture.Speed,
                tickMilliseconds);
        }

        foreach (var entity in snapshot.Where(entity => !entity.IsDisposed))
            interactions.ClearInvalidTarget(entity);

        PurgeDisposedEntities();
        RebuildSpatialIndexes();
    }

    private void PurgeDisposedEntities()
    {
        var disposed = entities.All
            .Where(entity => entity.IsDisposed)
            .ToArray();

        foreach (var entity in disposed)
        {
            if (TryResolveInstance(entity, out var instance))
                instance.Remove(entity);

            entities.Remove(entity);
        }
    }

    private void RebuildSpatialIndexes()
    {
        foreach (var instance in mapManager.All)
        {
            instance.Entities.RemoveDisposed(entity => entity.IsDisposed);
            instance.SpatialIndex.Rebuild(
                instance.Entities.All.Where(entity => !entity.IsDisposed));
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Entity lifecycle

    public void AddEntity(WorldEntity entity)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity);

        if (entity.IsDisposed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                "No se puede agregar una entidad destruida.");

        var instance = ResolveInstanceForEntity(entity);

        ValidateEntityPlacement(entity, instance);

        entities.Add(entity);

        try
        {
            instance.Add(entity);
        }
        catch
        {
            entities.Remove(entity);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public bool RemoveEntity(EntityId id)
    {
        if (!entities.TryGet(id, out var entity))
            return false;

        if (TryResolveInstance(entity, out var instance))
            instance.Remove(entity);

        entities.Remove(entity);

        entity.Dispose();

        foreach (var remaining in entities.All.Where(
                     candidate => candidate.Target == entity))
        {
            remaining.ClearTarget();
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void ValidateEntityPlacement(
        WorldEntity entity,
        MapInstance instance)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(
                entity.MapId,
                instance.Definition.Id,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"Entidad {entity.EntityId.Value} declara mapa '{entity.MapId}' " +
                $"pero se intentó colocar en '{instance.Definition.Id}'.");
        }

        if (!instance.Runtime.IsInside(
                entity.Position.X,
                entity.Position.Y))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Entidad fuera de los límites del mapa.");
        }

        if (!instance.Runtime.CanOccupy(
                entity.Position.X,
                entity.Position.Y))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Entidad en una celda bloqueada.");
        }
    }

    #endregion

    #region Targeting / interactions

    public bool TryTarget(
        EntityId sourceId,
        EntityId targetId,
        float? maximumRange = null)
    {
        if (!entities.TryGet(sourceId, out var source) ||
            !entities.TryGet(targetId, out var target))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!SharesRuntimeSpace(source, target))
            return false;

        if (!source.IsVisible || !target.IsVisible ||
            source.IsDisposed || target.IsDisposed)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return interactions.TryTarget(source, target, maximumRange);
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<WorldEntity> TargetCandidates(
        EntityId sourceId,
        EntityKind? kind = null)
    {
        if (!entities.TryGet(sourceId, out var source) ||
            source.IsDisposed)
        {
            return [];
        }

        if (!TryResolveInstance(source, out var instance))
            return [];

        return interactions.Candidates(
            source,
            instance.Entities.All.Where(entity =>
                !entity.IsDisposed &&
                entity.IsVisible &&
                (kind is null || entity.Kind == kind)),
            kind);
    }

    public string? TakeInteractionResult(Player player)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(player);

        return interactionResults.Remove(
            player.Token,
            out var result)
            ? result
            : null;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Movement / map transitions

    public bool TryTransition(
        Player player,
        string destinationMapId,
        string? spawnPointId = null)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(player);

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(destinationMapId))
            return false;

        MapInstance target;

        try
        {
            target = mapManager.Resolve(destinationMapId);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var spawn = ResolveSpawnPoint(target.Definition, spawnPointId);

        if (spawn is null)
            return false;

        var destination = new WorldPosition(spawn.X, spawn.Y);

        if (!target.Runtime.IsInside(destination.X, destination.Y) ||
            !target.Runtime.CanOccupy(destination.X, destination.Y))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!TryResolveInstance(player.Entity, out var source))
            return false;

        if (source.Id == target.Id)
        {
            player.Entity.Position = destination;
            player.Entity.ClearTarget();
            player.Entity.InputX = 0;
            player.Entity.InputY = 0;
            Persist(player);
            return true;
        }

        var oldCharacter = player.Character;
        var oldInstanceId = player.Entity.InstanceId;

        try
        {
            // 1. Sacar del runtime viejo.
            source.Remove(player.Entity);

            // 2. Cambiar estado autoritativo.
            player.Character = player.Character with
            {
                MapId = target.Definition.Id,
                Position = destination
            };

            player.Entity.InstanceId = default;
            player.Entity.ClearTarget();
            player.Entity.InputX = 0;
            player.Entity.InputY = 0;

            // 3. Insertar en runtime destino.
            target.Add(player.Entity);

            // 4. Invalidar referencias desde otras entidades.
            foreach (var entity in entities.All.Where(
                         entity => entity.Target == player.Entity &&
                                   !SharesRuntimeSpace(entity, player.Entity)))
            {
                entity.ClearTarget();
            }

            Persist(player);

            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            // Rollback runtime básico. La futura transición formal deberá vivir
            // en MapManager como operación atómica.
            if (target.Entities.All.Contains(player.Entity))
                target.Remove(player.Entity);

            player.Character = oldCharacter;
            player.Entity.InstanceId = default;

            if (!source.Entities.All.Contains(player.Entity))
            {
                source.Add(player.Entity);
                player.Entity.InstanceId = oldInstanceId;
            }

            throw;
        }
    }

    public bool TryRespawn(
        Player player,
        string mapId,
        WorldPosition position)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(player);

        if (player.Entity.LifeState != CharacterLifeState.Recovering)
            return false;

        var point = player.Entity.RespawnPoint;

        if (point is null)
            return false;

        MapInstance target;

        try
        {
            target = mapManager.Resolve(mapId);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var validSpawn = target.Definition.SpawnPoints.Any(spawn =>
            spawn.Id == point.Id &&
            spawn.X == position.X &&
            spawn.Y == position.Y);

        if (!validSpawn ||
            !target.Runtime.IsInside(position.X, position.Y) ||
            !target.Runtime.CanOccupy(position.X, position.Y))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // Si el respawn cambia de mapa, primero movemos runtime.
        if (!string.Equals(
                player.Character.MapId,
                mapId,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            if (!TryTransition(player, mapId, point.Id))
                return false;
        }

        var respawned = player.Entity.TryRespawn(mapId, position);

        if (respawned)
            Persist(player);

        return respawned;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Projectiles

    public ProjectileEntity SpawnProjectile(
        EntityId ownerId,
        WorldPosition direction,
        float speed,
        float range)
    {
        if (!entities.TryGet(ownerId, out var owner) ||
            owner.IsDisposed)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Propietario de proyectil inexistente.");
        }

        var projectile = new ProjectileEntity(
            owner,
            owner.MapId,
            owner.Position,
            direction,
            speed,
            range);

        projectile.InstanceId = owner.InstanceId;

        AddEntity(projectile);

        return projectile;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Inventory

    public Character AddInventoryItem(
        Player player,
        ItemInstance item)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(player);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(item);

        if (!itemDefinitions.TryGetValue(
                item.DefinitionId,
                out var definition))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Definición de objeto inexistente.");
        }

        player.Character = inventory.Add(
            player.Character,
            item,
            definition);

        Persist(player);

        return player.Character;
    }

    public Character RemoveInventoryItem(
        Player player,
        Guid itemId)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(player);

        player.Character = inventory.Remove(
            player.Character,
            itemId);

        Persist(player);

        return player.Character;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Replication snapshots

    public CharacterView[] Snapshot(Player viewer)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(viewer);

        var visibleIds = VisibleEntityIds(viewer);

        return entities.All
            .OfType<CharacterEntity>()
            .Where(entity =>
                entity.Connected &&
                entity.IsVisible &&
                !entity.IsDisposed &&
                visibleIds.Contains(entity.EntityId.Value))
            .Select(entity => BuildCharacterView(entity, viewer))
            .ToArray();
    }

    public EntityView[] SnapshotEntities()
    {
        return entities.All
            .Where(entity =>
                entity.IsVisible &&
                !entity.IsDisposed &&
                (entity is not CharacterEntity character ||
                 character.Connected))
            .Select(BuildEntityView)
            .ToArray();
    }

    public EntityView[] VisibleEntities(Player viewer)
    {
        ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(viewer);

        var instance = ResolveInstanceForEntity(viewer.Entity);

        var visibleIds = VisibleEntityIds(viewer, instance);

        return instance.Entities.All
            .Where(entity =>
                entity.IsVisible &&
                !entity.IsDisposed &&
                visibleIds.Contains(entity.EntityId.Value) &&
                (entity is not CharacterEntity character ||
                 character.Connected))
            .Select(entity =>
            {
                var view = BuildEntityView(entity);

                return view with
                {
                    TargetId = view.TargetId is { } targetId &&
                               visibleIds.Contains(targetId)
                        ? targetId
                        : null
                };
            })
            .ToArray();
    }

    private HashSet<long> VisibleEntityIds(
        Player viewer,
        MapInstance? resolvedInstance = null)
    {
        var instance = resolvedInstance
            ?? ResolveInstanceForEntity(viewer.Entity);

        return instance.SpatialIndex
            .Query(
                viewer.Character.Position,
                fixture.InterestRadius)
            .Where(entity =>
                !entity.IsDisposed &&
                entity.IsVisible &&
                entity.InstanceId == viewer.Entity.InstanceId &&
                string.Equals(
                    entity.MapId,
                    viewer.Character.MapId,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .Select(entity => entity.EntityId.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
    }

    private CharacterView BuildCharacterView(
        CharacterEntity entity,
        Player viewer)
    {
        var character = entity.Character;

        var inventoryView = entity == viewer.Entity
            ? character.Inventory
                .Select(item => BuildItemView(character, item))
                .ToArray()
            : [];

        return new CharacterView(
            entity.EntityId.Value,
            character.Name,
            character.MapId,
            character.Position.X,
            character.Position.Y,
            character.HP.Current,
            character.HP.Maximum,
            character.PM.Current,
            character.PM.Maximum,
            character.Attributes.Primary.ToDictionary(
                pair => pair.Key,
                pair => pair.Value),
            inventoryView,
            entity.LifeState);
    }

    private ItemView BuildItemView(
        Character character,
        ItemInstance item)
    {
        var name = itemDefinitions.TryGetValue(
            item.DefinitionId,
            out var definition)
            ? definition.Name
            : item.DefinitionId;

        return new ItemView(
            item.Id,
            item.DefinitionId,
            name,
            item.ResolvedProperties.ToDictionary(
                pair => pair.Key,
                pair => pair.Value),
            character.Equipment.Items.Values.Contains(item.Id));
    }

    private static EntityView BuildEntityView(WorldEntity entity)
    {
        var definitionId = entity switch
        {
            NpcEntity npc => npc.Definition.Id,
            CreatureEntity creature => creature.Definition.Id,
            _ => null
        };

        var name = entity switch
        {
            NpcEntity npc => npc.Definition.Name,
            CreatureEntity creature => creature.Definition.Name,
            _ => null
        };

        var visualId = entity.Kind switch
        {
            EntityKind.Character => "player",
            EntityKind.Npc => (entity as NpcEntity)?.Definition.VisualId ?? "npc",
            EntityKind.Creature => (entity as CreatureEntity)?.Definition.VisualId ?? "creature",
            _ => null
        };

        var targetId =
            entity.Target is
            {
                IsDisposed: false,
                IsVisible: true
            } target &&
            target.MapId == entity.MapId &&
            target.InstanceId == entity.InstanceId &&
            (target is not CharacterEntity targetCharacter ||
             targetCharacter.Connected)
                ? target.EntityId.Value
                : null;

        var moving =
            entity is CharacterEntity character &&
            character.CanReceiveInput &&
            (character.InputX != 0 || character.InputY != 0);

        return new EntityView(
            entity.EntityId.Value,
            entity.Kind.ToString(),
            entity.MapId,
            entity.Position.X,
            entity.Position.Y,
            definitionId,
            name,
            targetId,
            entity.Facing,
            moving,
            visualId);
    }

    #endregion

    #region Helpers

    private IMapManager BuildDefaultMapManager(
        MapCatalog maps,
        float spatialCellSize)
    {
        var manager = new MapManager();

        long instanceNumber = 1;

        foreach (var definition in maps.All)
        {
            manager.Register(
                new MapInstance(
                    new MapInstanceId(instanceNumber++),
                    definition,
                    spatialCellSize));
        }

        return manager;
    }

    private void SpawnInitialContent(ContentPackage? content)
    {
        if (content is null)
        {
            AddEntity(
                new NpcEntity(
                    new NpcDefinition(
                        "fixture-npc",
                        "Habitante de prueba"),
                    fixture.MapId,
                    new WorldPosition(
                        fixture.SpawnX + 24,
                        fixture.SpawnY)));

            return;
        }

        foreach (var spawn in content.NpcSpawns ?? [])
        {
            var definition = content.Npcs.Single(
                npc => npc.Id == spawn.NpcId);

            AddEntity(
                new NpcEntity(
                    definition,
                    spawn.MapId,
                    new WorldPosition(spawn.X, spawn.Y)));
        }

        foreach (var spawn in content.Spawns)
        {
            var variant = content.Variants.Single(
                candidate => candidate.Id == spawn.VariantId);

            AddEntity(
                new CreatureEntity(
                    new CreatureVariantDefinition(
                        variant.Id,
                        variant.Name,
                        variant.VisualId),
                    spawn.MapId,
                    new WorldPosition(spawn.X, spawn.Y)));
        }
    }

    private ItemInstance CreateStarterItem() =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            fixture.Item.Id,
            new Dictionary<string, decimal>(
                fixture.ResolvedProperties));

    private static string NormalizeCharacterName(string? name) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)
            ? "Personaje de prueba"
            : name.Trim();

    private void ValidateInventory(Character character)
    {
        foreach (var item in character.Inventory)
        {
            ItemValidation.Validate(
                itemCatalog.Get(item.DefinitionId),
                item);
        }
    }

    private void ValidateCharacterWorldState(Character character)
    {
        MapInstance instance;

        try
        {
            instance = mapManager.Resolve(character.MapId);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"El mapa guardado '{character.MapId}' no existe.",
                ex);
        }

        if (!instance.Runtime.IsInside(
                character.Position.X,
                character.Position.Y) ||
            !instance.Runtime.CanOccupy(
                character.Position.X,
                character.Position.Y))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "Posición guardada inválida.");
        }
    }

    private MapInstance ResolveInstanceForEntity(
        WorldEntity entity) =>
        mapManager.Resolve(
            entity.MapId,
            entity.InstanceId);

    private bool TryResolveInstance(
        WorldEntity entity,
        out MapInstance instance)
    {
        try
        {
            instance = ResolveInstanceForEntity(entity);
            return true;
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException)
        {
            instance = null!;
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static SpawnPoint? ResolveSpawnPoint(
        MapDefinition definition,
        string? spawnPointId)
    {
        if (definition.SpawnPoints.Count == 0)
            return null;

        return spawnPointId is null
            ? definition.SpawnPoints[0]
            : definition.SpawnPoints.FirstOrDefault(
                point => point.Id == spawnPointId);
    }

    private static bool SharesRuntimeSpace(
        WorldEntity left,
        WorldEntity right) =>
        left.InstanceId == right.InstanceId &&
        string.Equals(
            left.MapId,
            right.MapId,
            StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private void ValidateOwnedPlayer(Player player)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(player);

        if (!players.TryGetValue(
                player.Token,
                out var owned) ||
            !ReferenceEquals(owned, player))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException("Sesión no válida.");
        }
    }

    private void ValidateOwnedConnectedPlayer(Player player)
    {
        ValidateOwnedPlayer(player);

        if (!player.Connected)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Sesión desconectada.");
    }

    private void Persist(Player player)
    {
        repository?.Save(
            player.Token,
            player.Character);
    }

    #endregion
}

/// <summary>
/// Base runtime para toda entidad que existe dentro del mundo autoritativo.
/// 
/// Responsabilidades:
/// - identidad runtime;
/// - pertenencia a mapa/instancia heredada de MapEntity;
/// - posición/orientación;

/// No contiene reglas específicas de combate, IA, inventario, loot ni rendering.
/// </summary>
public abstract class WorldEntity : MapEntity
{
    public abstract override EntityId EntityId { get; }

    public abstract EntityKind Kind { get; }

    public abstract override string MapId { get; }

    public abstract override WorldPosition Position { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Objetivo runtime actual.
    /// Nunca debe considerarse una referencia persistente.
    /// </summary>
    public WorldEntity? Target { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Una entidad disposed deja de participar del runtime y debe ser purgada
    /// por World/MapInstance al finalizar el tick.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Controla si la entidad puede ser replicada/considerada visible.
    /// No reemplaza stealth, detección ni reglas de AOI futuras.
    /// </summary>
    public bool IsVisible { get; private set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Último tick autoritativo procesado por esta entidad.
    /// Útil para depuración, validaciones y sistemas futuros.
    /// </summary>
    public long LastUpdatedTick { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Intenta asignar un objetivo temporal.
    /// La validación espacial completa pertenece a World/InteractionSystem.
    /// Aquí solo se protegen invariantes locales de la entidad.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TrySetTarget(WorldEntity? target)
    {
        if (IsDisposed)
            return false;

        if (target is null ||
            target.IsDisposed ||
            ReferenceEquals(target, this))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // Nunca mantener referencias entre instancias diferentes.
        // Las reglas de alcance/distancia siguen siendo responsabilidad
        // del sistema que solicita el targeting.
        if (InstanceId.Value != 0 &&
            target.InstanceId.Value != 0 &&
            InstanceId != target.InstanceId)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!string.Equals(
                MapId,
                target.MapId,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return false;
        }

        Target = target;
        return true;
    }

    public void ClearTarget()
    {
        Target = null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Cambia la visibilidad lógica de la entidad.
    /// Una entidad disposed nunca puede volver a hacerse visible.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetVisible(bool visible)
    {
        if (IsDisposed)
            return;

        IsVisible = visible;

        if (!visible)
            ClearTargetReferencesToInvisibleState();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Hook base del tick autoritativo.
    /// Las clases derivadas pueden extenderlo llamando siempre a base.Update().
    /// </summary>
    public virtual void Update(long serverTick)
    {
        if (IsDisposed)
            return;

        if (serverTick < 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(serverTick),
                "El tick del servidor no puede ser negativo.");

        LastUpdatedTick = serverTick;

        ValidateTransientReferences();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Finaliza la participación de la entidad en el runtime.
    /// Es idempotente.
    /// </summary>
    public virtual void Dispose()
    {
        if (IsDisposed)
            return;

        IsDisposed = true;
        IsVisible = false;
        Target = null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Comprueba si otra entidad comparte el mismo espacio runtime.
    /// No verifica rango, colisión ni permisos.
    /// </summary>
    public bool SharesRuntimeSpace(WorldEntity other)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(other);

        if (IsDisposed || other.IsDisposed)
            return false;

        if (!string.Equals(
                MapId,
                other.MapId,
                StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return InstanceId.Value != 0 &&
               other.InstanceId.Value != 0 &&
               InstanceId == other.InstanceId;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Invalida referencias temporales cuando dejan de ser coherentes.
    /// </summary>
    protected virtual void ValidateTransientReferences()
    {
        if (Target is null)
            return;

        if (Target.IsDisposed ||
            !Target.IsVisible ||
            !SharesRuntimeSpace(Target))
        {
            Target = null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Al ocultarse la propia entidad no es necesario destruir su Target,
    /// pero hacerlo evita mantener referencias de gameplay mientras la
    /// entidad está excluida de replicación/interacción.
    /// </summary>
    private void ClearTargetReferencesToInvisibleState()
    {
        Target = null;
    }
}

    {
        if (RespawnPoint is null || LifeState != CharacterLifeState.Recovering ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(mapId) || !float.IsFinite(position.X) || !float.IsFinite(position.Y))
            return false;
        LifeState = CharacterLifeCycle.Respawn(LifeState, RespawnPoint);
        Character = Character with { MapId = mapId, Position = position };
        InputX = InputY = 0;
        return true;
    }

    public override void Dispose()
    {
        Connected = false;
        InputX = InputY = 0;
        base.Dispose();
    }

    private bool TryTransition(Func<CharacterLifeState, CharacterLifeState> transition)
    {
        if (IsDisposed) return false;
        CharacterLifeState next;
        try { next = transition(LifeState); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { return false; }
        LifeState = next;
        if (LifeState != CharacterLifeState.Alive)
            InputX = InputY = 0;
        return true;
    }

    private static string ValidateToken(string value) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? throw new ArgumentException("Token requerido.", nameof(value)) : value;

    private static Character ValidateCharacter(Character value)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(value);
        CharacterValidation.Validate(value);
        return value;
    }
}

using Mmo.Domain;

namespace Mmo.Server.Services;

public sealed class MovementService
{
    public const int InputTimeoutMilliseconds = 300;

    public void ApplyInput(CharacterEntity entity, float x, float y)
    {
        if (!entity.CanReceiveInput)
        {
            entity.InputX = entity.InputY = 0;
            return;
        }
        if (!float.IsFinite(x) || !float.IsFinite(y) || Math.Abs(x) > 1 || Math.Abs(y) > 1)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Direccion invalida.");
        var length = MathF.Sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        entity.InputX = length > 1 ? x / length : x;
        entity.InputY = length > 1 ? y / length : y;
        if(x!=0||y!=0)entity.Facing=Math.Abs(x)>Math.Abs(y)?(x<0?FacingDirection.Left:FacingDirection.Right):(y<0?FacingDirection.Up:FacingDirection.Down);
        entity.LastInputTimestamp = Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
    }

    public void Step(CharacterEntity entity, MapRuntime map, float speed, int tickMilliseconds)
    {
        if (!entity.CanReceiveInput)
        {
            entity.InputX = entity.InputY = 0;
            return;
        }
        if (Stopwatch.GetElapsedTime(entity.LastInputTimestamp).TotalMilliseconds > InputTimeoutMilliseconds)
            entity.InputX = entity.InputY = 0;
        var distance = speed * tickMilliseconds / 1000f;
        var current = entity.Character.Position;
        var proposed = new WorldPosition(current.X + entity.InputX * distance,
            current.Y + entity.InputY * distance);
        var bounded = map.Clamp(proposed);
        if (map.CanOccupy(bounded.X, bounded.Y))
            entity.Character = entity.Character with { Position = bounded };
    }
}

using Mmo.Domain;
using Mmo.Server.Entities;
using Mmo.Server.Maps;

namespace Mmo.Server.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Sistema autoritativo de movimiento para personajes.
/// 
/// Responsabilidades:
/// - validar y normalizar intención de movimiento;
/// - actualizar orientación;
/// - invalidar input vencido;
/// - integrar desplazamiento por tick;
/// - validar límites y colisión estática del mapa.
/// 
/// No conoce networking, Godot, cámara ni interpolación visual.
/// </summary>
public sealed class MovementService
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tiempo máximo sin recibir input antes de considerar la intención
    /// de movimiento vencida.
    /// </summary>
    public const int InputTimeoutMilliseconds = 300;

    /// <summary>
    /// Acepta intención de movimiento ya asociada a una sesión válida.
    /// El servidor normaliza vectores diagonales para evitar velocidad extra.
    /// </summary>
    public void ApplyInput(
        CharacterEntity entity,
        float x,
        float y)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity);

        if (!entity.CanReceiveInput)
        {
            entity.ClearMovementInput();
            return;
        }

        ValidateInput(x, y);

        var normalized = NormalizeInput(x, y);

        entity.SetMovementInput(
            normalized.X,
            normalized.Y);

        if (normalized.X != 0f ||
            normalized.Y != 0f)
        {
            entity.Facing = ResolveFacing(
                normalized.X,
                normalized.Y,
                entity.Facing);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Integra el movimiento del personaje durante un tick autoritativo.
    /// </summary>
    public MovementStepResult Step(
        CharacterEntity entity,
        MapRuntime map,
        float speed,
        int tickMilliseconds)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(map);

        if (!float.IsFinite(speed) || speed < 0f)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(speed),
                "La velocidad debe ser finita y no negativa.");
        }

        if (tickMilliseconds <= 0)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(tickMilliseconds),
                "La duración del tick debe ser positiva.");
        }

        if (!entity.CanReceiveInput)
        {
            entity.ClearMovementInput();

            return MovementStepResult.NoMovement(
                entity.Position,
                MovementBlockReason.EntityCannotMove);
        }

        if (IsInputExpired(entity))
        {
            entity.ClearMovementInput();

            return MovementStepResult.NoMovement(
                entity.Position,
                MovementBlockReason.InputExpired);
        }

        if (!entity.HasMovementInput || speed == 0f)
        {
            return MovementStepResult.NoMovement(
                entity.Position,
                MovementBlockReason.None);
        }

        var distance =
            speed *
            tickMilliseconds /
            1000f;

        var current = entity.Position;

        var desired = new WorldPosition(
            current.X + entity.InputX * distance,
            current.Y + entity.InputY * distance);

        var bounded = map.Clamp(desired);

        if (!map.CanOccupy(
                bounded.X,
                bounded.Y))
        {
            return MovementStepResult.Blocked(
                current,
                desired,
                bounded,
                MovementBlockReason.Collision);
        }

        if (PositionsEqual(current, bounded))
        {
            return MovementStepResult.NoMovement(
                current,
                MovementBlockReason.MapBounds);
        }

        entity.Position = bounded;

        return MovementStepResult.Moved(
            current,
            desired,
            bounded);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Detiene explícitamente el movimiento del personaje.
    /// Útil al cambiar de mapa, morir, abrir determinados estados, etc.
    /// </summary>
    public void Stop(CharacterEntity entity)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(entity);
        entity.ClearMovementInput();
    }

    private static void ValidateInput(
        float x,
        float y)
    {
        if (!float.IsFinite(x) ||
            !float.IsFinite(y))
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "La dirección contiene valores no finitos.");
        }

        if (MathF.Abs(x) > 1f ||
            MathF.Abs(y) > 1f)
        {
            throw new InvalidDataException(
                "La dirección está fuera del rango permitido.");
        }
    }

    private static WorldPosition NormalizeInput(
        float x,
        float y)
    {
        var lengthSquared =
            x * x +
            y * y;

        if (lengthSquared <= 1f)
        {
            return new WorldPosition(
                x,
                y);
        }

        var inverseLength =
            1f /
            MathF.Sqrt(lengthSquared);

        return new WorldPosition(
            x * inverseLength,
            y * inverseLength);
    }

    private static FacingDirection ResolveFacing(
        float x,
        float y,
        FacingDirection current)
    {
        var absX = MathF.Abs(x);
        var absY = MathF.Abs(y);

        if (absX == 0f &&
            absY == 0f)
        {
            return current;
        }

        if (absX > absY)
        {
            return x < 0f
                ? FacingDirection.Left
                : FacingDirection.Right;
        }

        if (absY > absX)
        {
            return y < 0f
                ? FacingDirection.Up
                : FacingDirection.Down;
        }

        // Empate diagonal:
        // conservar eje previo cuando sea coherente evita que el personaje
        // oscile visualmente entre horizontal y vertical por pequeñas variaciones.
        return current switch
        {
            FacingDirection.Left when x < 0f => FacingDirection.Left,
            FacingDirection.Right when x > 0f => FacingDirection.Right,
            FacingDirection.Up when y < 0f => FacingDirection.Up,
            FacingDirection.Down when y > 0f => FacingDirection.Down,

            _ => y < 0f
                ? FacingDirection.Up
                : FacingDirection.Down
        };
    }

    private static bool IsInputExpired(
        CharacterEntity entity) =>
        Stopwatch
            .GetElapsedTime(entity.LastInputTimestamp)
            .TotalMilliseconds >
        InputTimeoutMilliseconds;

    private static bool PositionsEqual(
        WorldPosition left,
        WorldPosition right) =>
        left.X == right.X &&
        left.Y == right.Y;
}

/// <summary>
/// Resultado interno del paso de movimiento.
/// Sirve para tests, depuración, eventos y futura reconciliación sin acoplar
/// MovementService al protocolo de red.
/// </summary>
public readonly record struct MovementStepResult(
    bool DidMove,
    WorldPosition PreviousPosition,
    WorldPosition DesiredPosition,
    WorldPosition FinalPosition,
    MovementBlockReason BlockReason)
{
    public static MovementStepResult Moved(
        WorldPosition previous,
        WorldPosition desired,
        WorldPosition final) =>
        new(
            true,
            previous,
            desired,
            final,
            MovementBlockReason.None);

    public static MovementStepResult Blocked(
        WorldPosition previous,
        WorldPosition desired,
        WorldPosition final,
        MovementBlockReason reason) =>
        new(
            false,
            previous,
            desired,
            final,
            reason);

    public static MovementStepResult NoMovement(
        WorldPosition position,
        MovementBlockReason reason) =>
        new(
            false,
            position,
            position,
            position,
            reason);
}

public enum MovementBlockReason
{
    None = 0,
    EntityCannotMove = 1,
    InputExpired = 2,
    Collision = 3,
    MapBounds = 4
}

                handshake.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
                var hello = await Frames.ReadAsync<ClientMessage>(stream, handshake.Token);
                ProtocolValidation.ValidateHandshake(hello);
                lock (world.Gate)
                {
                    player = hello.Kind switch
                    {
                        MessageKinds.CreateCharacter => world.CreateCharacter(hello.CharacterName),
                        MessageKinds.LoadCharacter => world.LoadCharacter(hello.ResumeToken!),
                        _ => world.Join(hello.ResumeToken)
                    };
                }
                await Frames.WriteAsync(stream, new ServerMessage(Wire.Version, MessageKinds.Welcome,
                    player.Entity.EntityId.Value, player.Token, MapWidth: world.Width, MapHeight: world.Height), handshake.Token);
                receive = ReceiveAsync(stream, player, lifetime.Token);
                var replication = new ReplicationSession();
                using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(rates.NetworkMs));
                while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(lifetime.Token))
                {

                    lock (world.Gate)

                    using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(lifetime.Token);

                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or InvalidDataException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException or JsonException)
            {
                if (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"Sesion cerrada: {ex.Message}");

                    {
                        using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(500);
                        await Frames.WriteAsync(stream, new ServerMessage(Wire.Version, MessageKinds.Error, Error: ex.Message), timeout.Token);

                    catch (Exception writeError) when (writeError is IOException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException) { }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                lifetime.Cancel();
                if (receive is not null)
                {
                    try { await receive; }
                    catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or InvalidDataException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException or JsonException) { }
                }
                if (player is not null) lock (world.Gate) world.Leave(player);
            }
        }
    }
    private async Task ReceiveAsync(Stream stream, World.Player player, CancellationToken stop)
    {
        var dispatcher = new PacketDispatcher();
        foreach(var kind in new[]{"move","equip","target","interact"})dispatcher.Register(kind,world.Apply);
        var window = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        int count = 0;
        while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(stop);
            deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
            var message = await Frames.ReadAsync<ClientMessage>(stream, deadline.Token);
            if (window.Elapsed.TotalSeconds >= 1) { count = 0; window.Restart(); }
            if (++count > 100) throw new InvalidDataException("Demasiados comandos.");
            lock (world.Gate) dispatcher.Dispatch(player, message);
        }
    }
}

namespace Mmo.Server;

/// <summary>
/// Host TCP local del servidor autoritativo.
/// 
/// Responsabilidades:
/// - escuchar conexiones;
/// - ejecutar handshake;
/// - asociar una conexión a una sesión/player;
/// - recibir comandos y entregarlos al dispatcher;
/// - enviar replicación periódica;

/// - cerrar sesiones de forma ordenada.

/// No contiene reglas de gameplay.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LocalServer
{
    private const int DefaultBacklog = 64;
    private const int MaxConcurrentSessions = 64;

    private static readonly TimeSpan HandshakeTimeout =
        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);

    private static readonly TimeSpan ReceiveTimeout =
        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

    private static readonly TimeSpan SendTimeout =
        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    private static readonly TimeSpan ErrorSendTimeout =
        TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500);

    private readonly World world;
    private readonly ServerRates rates;
    private readonly IReplicationSystem replicationSystem;

    public LocalServer(
        World world,
        ServerRates? rates = null,
        IReplicationSystem? replicationSystem = null)
    {
        this.world = world ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(world));
        this.rates = rates ?? new ServerRates();
        this.replicationSystem = replicationSystem ?? new ReplicationSystem();
    }

    public TaskCompletionSource<int> Ready { get; } =
        new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);

    public async Task RunAsync(
        int port,
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        rates.Validate();

        if (port is < 0 or > 65535)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
                nameof(port),
                "El puerto debe estar entre 0 y 65535.");
        }

        using var slots = new SemaphoreSlim(
            MaxConcurrentSessions,
            MaxConcurrentSessions);

        var sessions = new HashSet<Task>();

        var listener = new TcpListener(
            IPAddress.Loopback,
            port);

        listener.Start(DefaultBacklog);

        var boundPort =
            ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port;

        Ready.TrySetResult(boundPort);

        Console.WriteLine(
            $"Servidor local en 127.0.0.1:{boundPort}");

        var ticking = TickLoopAsync(stop);
        var saving = PersistenceLoopAsync(stop);

        try
        {
            while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                TcpClient client;

                try
                {
                    client =
                        await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(stop);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stop.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }

                if (!slots.Wait(0))
                {
                    client.Dispose();
                    continue;
                }

                RemoveCompletedSessions(sessions);

                var sessionTask =
                    ServeAndReleaseAsync(
                        client,
                        slots,
                        stop);

                sessions.Add(sessionTask);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            listener.Stop();

            await AwaitIgnoringCancellationAsync(
                sessions.ToArray());

            await AwaitIgnoringCancellationAsync(
                ticking,
                saving);

            lock (world.Gate)
            {
                world.Checkpoint();
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task TickLoopAsync(
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        using var timer =
            new PeriodicTimer(
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(
                    rates.SimulationMs));

        try
        {
            while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stop))
            {
                lock (world.Gate)
                {
                    world.Step(
                        rates.SimulationMs);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
            when (stop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
    }

    private async Task PersistenceLoopAsync(
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        using var timer =
            new PeriodicTimer(
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(
                    rates.PersistenceMs));

        try
        {
            while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stop))
            {
                lock (world.Gate)
                {
                    world.Checkpoint();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
            when (stop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
        }
    }

    private async Task ServeAndReleaseAsync(
        TcpClient client,
        SemaphoreSlim slots,
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        try
        {
            await ServeAsync(
                client,
                stop);
        }
        finally
        {
            slots.Release();
        }
    }

    private async Task ServeAsync(
        TcpClient client,
        CancellationToken serverStop)
    {
        using (client)
        using (var lifetime =
               CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                   serverStop))
        {
            client.NoDelay = true;

            World.Player? player = null;
            Task? receiveTask = null;

            var stream = client.GetStream();

            await using IGameTransport transport =
                new StreamGameTransport(stream);

            try
            {
                player = await PerformHandshakeAsync(
                    transport,
                    lifetime.Token);

                receiveTask =
                    ReceiveLoopAsync(
                        transport,
                        player,
                        lifetime.Token);

                await ReplicationLoopAsync(
                    transport,
                    player,
                    receiveTask,
                    lifetime.Token);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
                when (IsExpectedSessionException(
                    ex,
                    serverStop))
            {
                if (!serverStop.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine(
                        $"Sesión cerrada: {ex.Message}");

                    await TrySendErrorAsync(
                        transport,
                        ex.Message);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                lifetime.Cancel();

                if (receiveTask is not null)
                    await AwaitReceiveShutdownAsync(
                        receiveTask);

                if (player is not null)
                {
                    lock (world.Gate)
                    {
                        if (player.Connected)
                            world.Leave(player);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task<World.Player> PerformHandshakeAsync(
        IGameTransport transport,
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        using var timeout =
            CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                stop);

        timeout.CancelAfter(
            HandshakeTimeout);

        var hello =
            await transport.ReceiveAsync<ClientMessage>(
                timeout.Token);

        ProtocolValidation.ValidateHandshake(
            hello);

        World.Player player;

        lock (world.Gate)
        {
            player = hello.Kind switch
            {
                MessageKinds.CreateCharacter =>
                    world.CreateCharacter(
                        hello.CharacterName),

                MessageKinds.LoadCharacter =>
                    world.LoadCharacter(
                        hello.ResumeToken!),

                MessageKinds.Join =>
                    world.Join(
                        hello.ResumeToken),

                _ =>
                    throw new InvalidDataException(
                        $"Handshake no soportado: {hello.Kind}")
            };
        }

        var instance = ResolvePlayerMapSize(player);

        var welcome =
            new ServerMessage(
                Wire.Version,
                MessageKinds.Welcome,
                player.Entity.EntityId.Value,
                player.Token,
                MapWidth: instance.Width,
                MapHeight: instance.Height);

        await transport.SendAsync(
            welcome,
            timeout.Token);

        return player;
    }

    private async Task ReplicationLoopAsync(
        IGameTransport transport,
        World.Player player,
        Task receiveTask,
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        using var timer =
            new PeriodicTimer(
                TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(
                    rates.NetworkMs));

        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stop))
        {
            if (receiveTask.IsCompleted)
            {
                await receiveTask;
                return;
            }

            ServerMessage replication;

            lock (world.Gate)
            {
                replication =
                    replicationSystem.Build(
                        world,
                        player);
            }

            using var deadline =
                CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                    stop);

            deadline.CancelAfter(
                SendTimeout);

            await transport.SendAsync(
                replication,
                deadline.Token);
        }
    }

    private async Task ReceiveLoopAsync(
        IGameTransport transport,
        World.Player player,
        CancellationToken stop)
    {
        var dispatcher =
            BuildDispatcher();

        var rateLimiter =
            new SessionCommandRateLimiter(
                maximumCommands: 100,
                window: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));

        while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            using var deadline =
                CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(
                    stop);

            deadline.CancelAfter(
                ReceiveTimeout);

            var message =
                await transport.ReceiveAsync<ClientMessage>(
                    deadline.Token);

            rateLimiter.ThrowIfExceeded();

            lock (world.Gate)
            {
                dispatcher.Dispatch(
                    player,
                    message);
            }
        }
    }

    private PacketDispatcher BuildDispatcher()
    {
        var dispatcher =
            new PacketDispatcher();

        dispatcher.Register(
            MessageKinds.Move,
            world.Apply);

        dispatcher.Register(
            MessageKinds.Equip,
            world.Apply);

        dispatcher.Register(
            MessageKinds.Target,
            world.Apply);

        dispatcher.Register(
            MessageKinds.Interact,
            world.Apply);

        return dispatcher;
    }

    private (int Width, int Height)
        ResolvePlayerMapSize(
            World.Player player)
    {
        var definition =
            world.Maps.All.FirstOrDefault(
                map => string.Equals(
                    map.Id,
                    player.Character.MapId,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException(
                $"El mapa '{player.Character.MapId}' no existe.");

        return (
            definition.Width,
            definition.Height);
    }

    private static async Task TrySendErrorAsync(
        IGameTransport transport,
        string message)
    {
        try
        {
            using var timeout =
                new CancellationTokenSource(
                    ErrorSendTimeout);

            await transport.SendAsync(
                new ServerMessage(
                    Wire.Version,
                    MessageKinds.Error,
                    Error: message),
                timeout.Token);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
            when (ex is IOException
                or SocketException
                or OperationCanceledException
                or ObjectDisposedException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static bool IsExpectedSessionException(
        Exception ex,
        CancellationToken serverStop)
    {
        if (ex is OperationCanceledException &&
            serverStop.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            return true;
        }

        return ex is IOException
            or InvalidDataException
            or SocketException
            or OperationCanceledException
            or JsonException
            or ObjectDisposedException;
    }

    private static async Task AwaitReceiveShutdownAsync(
        Task receiveTask)
    {
        try
        {
            await receiveTask;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
            when (ex is IOException
                or InvalidDataException
                or SocketException
                or OperationCanceledException
                or JsonException
                or ObjectDisposedException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static async Task AwaitIgnoringCancellationAsync(
        params Task[] tasks)
    {
        foreach (var task in tasks)
        {
            try
            {
                await task;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
        }
    }

    private static void RemoveCompletedSessions(
        HashSet<Task> sessions)
    {
        sessions.RemoveWhere(
            task => task.IsCompleted);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Rate limit simple por sesión.
    /// Es una protección de transporte, no una regla de gameplay.
    /// </summary>
    private sealed class SessionCommandRateLimiter(
        int maximumCommands,
        TimeSpan window)
    {
        private readonly Stopwatch stopwatch =
            Stopwatch.StartNew();

        private int count;

        public void ThrowIfExceeded()
        {
            if (stopwatch.Elapsed >= window)
            {
                count = 0;
                stopwatch.Restart();
            }

            count++;

            if (count > maximumCommands)
            {
                throw new InvalidDataException(
                    "Demasiados comandos.");
            }
        }
    }
}

Listo. Este lo llevé de “servidor TCP local funcional” a **host de sesiones/transporte mucho más limpio**, sin meterle gameplay.

[Descargar `LocalServer_refinado.cs`](sandbox:/mnt/data/LocalServer_refinado.cs)

Lo principal que cambié es que ahora usa la abstracción `IGameTransport` en vez de llamar directamente a `Frames` por todo el archivo. Eso nos deja preparado para que más adelante debajo podamos tener TCP fiable, UDP secuenciado o lo que decidamos, sin reescribir `LocalServer`.

También separé claramente los flujos:

```text
RunAsync
├─ Accept loop
├─ TickLoopAsync
├─ PersistenceLoopAsync
└─ Session tasks

Session
├─ PerformHandshakeAsync
├─ ReceiveLoopAsync
└─ ReplicationLoopAsync
```

Eso facilita muchísimo mantenerlo.

Además:

- `IReplicationSystem` se inyecta.
- `ReplicationSession` deja de crearse directamente dentro de cada sesión.
- El `Welcome` usa el tamaño del mapa **real del personaje**, no `world.Width/world.Height` asumidos globales.
- Handshake, recepción, envío y error tienen timeouts separados.
- El shutdown intenta esperar correctamente sesiones/tick/persistencia.
- El límite de sesiones queda centralizado.
- El rate-limit queda encapsulado en `SessionCommandRateLimiter`.
- Ya no aparecen strings `"move"`, `"equip"`, `"target"`, `"interact"` regados.
- `PacketDispatcher` se configura en un método propio.
- El host no conoce reglas de movimiento, inventario ni interacción.
- Las excepciones esperables de socket/protocolo quedan centralizadas.
- El checkpoint final sigue garantizado.
- La conexión se libera siempre y el slot del semáforo también.

Hay dos requisitos de integración con lo que refinamos antes.

Primero, `MessageKinds` debe tener ya:

```csharp
public const string Interact = "interact";
```

Segundo, `World.Leave()` en la versión refinada usa la nueva lógica de conexión. Si `PlayerSession` ya se encarga internamente de `TryConnect()/TryDisconnect()`, perfecto. Si todavía modifica `Entity.Connected` directamente, ése será uno de los siguientes archivos que debemos actualizar.

Y hay una decisión técnica que deliberadamente **todavía no implementé**: esto sigue siendo un único TCP para recepción y replicación. La arquitectura ya deja el hueco:

```text
LocalServer
    ↓
IGameTransport
```

Más adelante podremos evolucionar hacia algo como:

```text
GameConnection
├─ ReliableChannel
│   └─ TCP / QUIC / equivalente
│
└─ SequencedChannel
    └─ UDP / equivalente
```

sin tocar gameplay.

El próximo archivo que yo revisaría ahora es **`ReplicationSession.cs` / `ReplicationSystem.cs`**, porque ahí es donde ya podemos empezar a abandonar snapshots completos y construir correctamente:

```text
AOI anterior
    vs
AOI actual
    ↓
Enter
Delta
Leave
```

Ese cambio va a ser uno de los saltos más importantes hacia networking MMO de verdad.

namespace Mmo.Protocol;

public static class MessageKinds
{
    public const string Join = "join";
    public const string CreateCharacter = "create_character";
    public const string LoadCharacter = "load_character";
    public const string Move = "move";
    public const string Equip = "equip";
    public const string Target = "target";
    public const string Welcome = "welcome";
    public const string Snapshot = "snapshot";
    public const string Error = "error";
}

public static class ProtocolValidation
{
    public static void ValidateJoin(ClientMessage message)
    {
        ValidateHandshake(message);
        if (message.Kind != MessageKinds.Join)
            throw new InvalidDataException("El primer paquete debe ser join.");
    }

    public static void ValidateHandshake(ClientMessage message)
    {
        ValidateVersion(message.Version);
        if (message.Sequence != 0)
            throw new InvalidDataException("El handshake no lleva secuencia.");
        if (message.Kind is not (MessageKinds.Join or MessageKinds.CreateCharacter or MessageKinds.LoadCharacter))
            throw new InvalidDataException("El primer paquete debe crear o cargar un personaje.");
        if (message.Kind == MessageKinds.CreateCharacter && message.ResumeToken is not null)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Crear personaje no acepta token de reanudación.");
        if (message.Kind == MessageKinds.LoadCharacter && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.ResumeToken))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Cargar personaje requiere token de reanudación.");
        if (message.CharacterName is not null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.CharacterName))
            throw new InvalidDataException("El nombre de personaje no puede estar vacío.");
    }

    public static void ValidateCommand(ClientMessage message, long lastSequence)
    {
        ValidateVersion(message.Version);
        if (message.Kind is not (MessageKinds.Move or MessageKinds.Equip or MessageKinds.Target or "interact"))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Comando desconocido.");
        if (message.Kind == "interact" && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.InteractionId)) throw new InvalidDataException("Interacción sin ID.");
        if (message.Sequence <= lastSequence) throw new InvalidDataException("Secuencia repetida.");
        if (message.Kind == MessageKinds.Move &&
            (!float.IsFinite(message.X) || !float.IsFinite(message.Y) || Math.Abs(message.X) > 1 || Math.Abs(message.Y) > 1))
            throw new InvalidDataException("Direccion invalida.");
        if (message.Kind == MessageKinds.Equip && message.ItemId is null)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Equipamiento sin objeto.");
        if (message.Kind is MessageKinds.Target or "interact" && message.TargetId is not > 0)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Objetivo sin entidad.");
    }

    public static void ValidateVersion(int version)
    {
        if (version != Wire.Version) throw new InvalidDataException("Version incompatible.");
    }
}

public static class MessageKinds

        Interact
    ];
